# Variable `BB_HASHSERVE_UPSTREAM`

### Yocto Project Reference Manual

See BB_HASHSERVE_UPSTREAM in the BitBake manual.

### BitBake User Manual

Specifies an upstream Hash Equivalence server.

This optional setting is only useful when a local Hash Equivalence server is started (setting BB_HASHSERVE to `auto`), and you wish the local server to query an upstream server for Hash Equivalence data.

Example usage:

```
BB_HASHSERVE_UPSTREAM = "hashserv.yoctoproject.org:8686"

```
